about: The web push payload each subscribed device is sent, before encryption (refactor plan step S10). The override run sets OPENV_PUSH_NOTIFICATION_TYPES to exactly the types the default allow-list leaves out.

deliveries.scenario: org.member_added: an admin adds a member

sends.payload: {"title":"You joined a workspace","body":"You are now a member of this workspace with a member role.","url":"/org/settings?tab=members","tag":"access_changed:org-acme"}

deliveries.scenario: org.member_role_changed: a member is made an admin

sends.payload: {"title":"Your workspace access changed","body":"Your role in this workspace is now an admin.","url":"/org/settings?tab=members","tag":"access_changed:org-acme"}
{"title":"You were removed from a workspace","body":"You no longer have access to this workspace.","url":"/org/settings?tab=members","tag":"access_changed:org-acme"}
{"title":"You were added to a project","body":"You now have editor access to this project.","url":"/projects/proj-apollo/settings?tab=members","tag":"access_changed:proj-apollo"}
{"title":"Your project access changed","body":"Your role in this project is now a viewer.","url":"/projects/proj-apollo/settings?tab=members","tag":"access_changed:proj-apollo"}
{"title":"You were removed from a project","body":"You no longer have access to this project.","url":"/projects/proj-apollo/settings?tab=members","tag":"access_changed:proj-apollo"}
